message.reasoning_content:
The watch is a Vacheron Constantin Historiques American 1921. Reference 82035/000R-9354 (rose gold, 40mm). There's also 82035/000P-9535 (platinum). The one pictured is rose gold with white dial... Actually the American 1921 has a silvered/white dial with black Arabic numerals, rose gold case, brown alligator strap.

Reference numbers: 82035/000R-9354 is the 40mm rose gold version. There's also 82035/000R-9746? Let me think. The Historiques American 1921 40mm rose gold: 82035/000R-9354. The platinum version is 82035/000P-9535. There is also a 36.5mm version, reference 1100S? Actually the 36.5mm is 1100S/000R-B430? Hmm.

The image shows a cushion-shaped case, dial rotated 45 degrees, crown at 1-2 o'clock position, small seconds at 3 o'clock position (rotated), rose gold case, brown leather strap. This matches the 40mm American 1921 in rose gold, ref. 82035/000R-9354.

Movement: manual wind (caliber 4400 AS). Case material: gold (rose gold). Bracelet: leather (alligator).

Confidence: ~0.75.
